summary: Turkcell filed a Form 6-K announcing the appointment of PwC as its independent audit firm for 2026, subject to shareholder approval at the May 7, 2026 Ordinary General Assembly. This is a routine auditor appointment—a standard corporate governance matter, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or forced management change is disclosed. The filing is an ordinary foreign private issuer update under Rule 13a-16. No deal terms or premiums are applicable; the event is purely administrative.
